goal: Implement Task 2 of the approved integrated plan: route every direct canvas creation path through one captured viewport, persist viewport-normalized size/font/contentScale once, preserve internal/imported geometry, and add deterministic AI sizing.
non_goals: Do not implement collision or snapping policies from Task 3 onward.
Do not change permanent-shell, chat HUD, AI index, credentials, backup or release behavior.
Do not install or upgrade dependencies.
Do not read, print or modify provider credentials.
acceptance_criteria: Draw, paste, link, external file/image/video drop and picker ingestion capture one immutable viewport at operation start and never re-read the live viewport during that operation.
Screen-intent dimensions and default font size are converted once to canvas units; contentScale is round4(1/capturedZoom).
Internal paste and duplicate preserve stored canvas geometry; full-canvas JSON and Mermaid imports preserve imported geometry.
AI node sizing ignores camera zoom and deterministically prefers target, then up to three nearest same-type nodes within 1200 canvas units, then the 100-percent fallback.
Style editing displays screen-observed font size from the captured menu viewport and persists one validated 8-96px submission converted to canvas units.
Resizing an existing outer frame does not rewrite font size, media content or contentScale.
Focused tests, the canvas suite, TypeScript check and diff check pass.
The implementation is committed and independently reviewed for spec compliance and task quality.
notes: Use fixed UTF-8 I/O for every non-ASCII read, search, edit and test output.
Follow strict TDD and record the expected failing focused tests before implementation.
Treat canvas-editor.tsx as manually bounded read-first context rather than an L2 semantic entrypoint to avoid expanding through the full React shell.
Do not expose or change configured provider secrets.
